title: FindingEnvelope
description: The structured report contract every self-hosted engine arm returns for a case. This is the same envelope hyperneo-review uses in production; raw outputs are stored exactly as the engine produced them, and the parsed form of a valid output conforms to this schema.

verdict.description: clean = no findings and no blocking (P0/P1) context_findings; concerns = at least one finding or a blocking context_finding.

summary.description: Short closing statement, preferably a coverage statement naming what was inspected and what stayed out of scope.

context_findings.description: Minor pre-existing notes the change makes relevant, anchored in pre-existing code.

severity.description: P0 = bug, security issue, data loss or release blocker. P1 = likely bug or clear repository-policy violation. P2 = minor/nit.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the changed file, at the reviewed revision.

line.description: Line number in the reviewed version of the file.

detail.description: What is wrong, why it matters, and the suggested fix.

not_in_diff.description: Set by the harness when the anchor exists in the file but not on a line the diff touched; the finding is then reported in the body instead of as an inline comment.
